name: Faraday Waves
desc: A vertically-vibrated fluid surface that spontaneously patterns into a shimmering lattice of standing-wave cells — squares, hexagons, stripes and quasicrystal tilings pulse and re-tile under backlit teal-and-indigo water with bright caustic crests.

scale.doc: cell size / lattice frequency (higher = smaller, denser cells)

energy.doc: wave relief + caustic contrast (higher = brighter, sharper crests)

density.doc: lattice richness (extra wave modes / finer tiling)

drive.doc: parametric vibration depth (pulsing of the caustic crests)

style.doc: render philosophy: backlit-water / silver mercury / thermal false-color / iridescent oil-film / height greyscale
